Message.Name: Order Add Message
Message.Description: Generated when an order is placed in the order book. An incoming, aggressing order that matches against one or more resting orders is not published as an Order Add unless it has residual volume after matching. For orders submitted during Pre-Open and reloaded GTC and GTD orders the TimeOfEvent reflects the uncrossing event time at market open.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time LMEselect added this order to the order book. For reloaded GTC and GTD orders this is the uncrossing event time.

Field.Name: T1
Field.Description: The time of the order request from the LMEselect gateway. Null for reloaded GTC and GTD, stop loss and speedbump orders.

Field.Name: T2
Field.Description: The time when LMEselect captured the order request. Null for reloaded GTC and GTD, stop loss and speedbump orders.

Field.Name: T3
Field.Description: The time when LMEselect published this order request to LMEsource. Null for reloaded GTC and GTD, stop loss and speedbump orders. The specification types this field Unit64, a typo for Uint64; the stated length of eight bytes agrees.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of order, in implicit six decimal place format.

Field.Name: OrderBookPosition
Field.Description: Relative order position within this side of the order book based upon price and time priority.
